the regulation of DNA repair and cell cycle progression following UV irradiation.

the role of p53 in the regulation of transcription-coupled excision repair (TCR) and the role of TCR in p53-dependent apoptosis.

UV-irradiation induces a block to Ad DNA replication in human fibroblastic cells, which is correlated with TCR of UV-induced DNA damage and is disrupted by expression of mutant p 53.
